verdict.rationale: First-party docs make general claims: Cowork handles 'bigger, multi-step tasks and deliver[s] completed to-dos', Copilot can 'automate repetitive tasks, no coding required', and it lets you 'hand off repetitive work'. The concrete agentic feature, Browse with Copilot, runs visibly in your browser with real-time supervision and approval prompts, so it is not a background automation. Missing for 10: documented setup of scheduled or triggered automations, evidence that tasks run unattended in the background, details of how to configure or manage automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
